Use Rails in API-only mode; the frontend is a separate app.
Ruby, Rails, Puma, and PostgreSQL are installed. If you need anything else, install it yourself.

Now let customers contact a business through its portal. They register with
`POST /api/v1/registrations`, for example
`{"user":{"name":"Avery","email":"avery@example.test","password":"my-customer-password"}}`.
They should use the existing verification, login, profile, and recovery flows.

A customer opens a request like this:

```http
POST /api/v1/requests

{"request":{"subject":"Cannot download my receipt","comment":{"body":"The download button does nothing."}}}
```

Return it inside `request`, with its ID, subject, status, requester ID, and timestamps. A new
request is open. Customers can list their own requests, open one, and read its comments at
`/requests`, `/requests/:id`, and `/requests/:id/comments`. Staff have the corresponding `/tickets`
routes; return records inside `ticket` there and include the requester as `{"id":10,"name":"Avery","email":"avery@example.test"}`.
Lists use the plural resource name. Comments include their body, author (`id` and `name`), whether
they're `public`, and when they were created.

Replies go through PATCH. For example, the owner can answer and mark a ticket pending:

```http
PATCH /api/v1/tickets/42

{"ticket":{"comment":{"body":"Please try again now."},"status":"pending"}}
```

Customers reply through `/requests/:id` with the `request` envelope. Customer replies reopen pending
or solved requests unless they mark the request solved in the same update. Staff can choose open, pending,
or solved. Posting a staff reply by itself doesn't change the status.

Paginate lists with `page` and `per_page` (default 1 and 25), returning `count`, `page`, `per_page`,
`next_page`, and `previous_page` alongside the records. Show recently active tickets and requests
first, and comments oldest first. This is a portal-only conversation for now; replies don't send email.

require_relative "helpdesk_config"

class CorsMiddleware
  DEFAULT_ALLOW_METHODS = "GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD"
  DEFAULT_ALLOW_HEADERS = %w[Authorization Content-Type X-Helpdesk-Account Accept].freeze
  MAX_AGE = "7200"

  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    origin = env["HTTP_ORIGIN"]
    origin_allowed = !origin.nil? && !origin.empty? && origin == HelpdeskConfig.frontend_origin

    if env["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "OPTIONS"
      return handle_preflight(env, origin, origin_allowed)
    end

    status, headers, body = @app.call(env)
    append_vary_origin(headers)

    if origin_allowed
      headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = origin
    end

    [ status, headers, body ]
  end

  private

  def handle_preflight(env, origin, origin_allowed)
    unless origin_allowed
      return [ 403, { "Vary" => "Origin" }, [] ]
    end

    requested_headers = env["HTTP_ACCESS_CONTROL_REQUEST_HEADERS"].to_s
      .split(",")
      .map(&:strip)
      .reject(&:empty?)

    merged_headers = DEFAULT_ALLOW_HEADERS.dup
    requested_headers.each do |header|
      merged_headers << header unless merged_headers.any? { |h| h.casecmp?(header) }
    end

class CorsMiddleware
  DEFAULT_ALLOW_METHODS = "GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD"
  DEFAULT_ALLOW_HEADERS = %w[Authorization Content-Type X-Helpdesk-Account Accept].freeze
  MAX_AGE = "7200"

  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    origin = env["HTTP_ORIGIN"]
    origin_allowed = !origin.nil? && !origin.empty? && origin == HelpdeskConfig.frontend_origin

    if env["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "OPTIONS"
      return handle_preflight(env, origin, origin_allowed)
    end

    status, headers, body = @app.call(env)
    append_vary_origin(headers)

    if origin_allowed
      headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = origin
    end

    [ status, headers, body ]
  end

  private

  def handle_preflight(env, origin, origin_allowed)
    unless origin_allowed
      return [ 403, { "Vary" => "Origin" }, [] ]
    end

    requested_headers = env["HTTP_ACCESS_CONTROL_REQUEST_HEADERS"].to_s
      .split(",")
      .map(&:strip)
      .reject(&:empty?)

    merged_headers = DEFAULT_ALLOW_HEADERS.dup
    requested_headers.each do |header|
      merged_headers << header unless merged_headers.any? { |h| h.casecmp?(header) }
    end

    headers = {
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" => origin,
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods" => DEFAULT_ALLOW_METHODS,
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers" => merged_headers.join(", "),
      "Access-Control-Max-Age" => MAX_AGE,
      "Vary" => "Origin"
    }

    [ 204, headers, [] ]
  end

    existing_key = headers.keys.find { |k| k.downcase == "vary" }
    if existing_key
      values = headers[existing_key].to_s.split(",").map(&:strip)
      unless values.any? { |v| v.casecmp?("Origin") }
        headers[existing_key] = (values + [ "Origin" ]).join(", ")
      end
    else
      headers["Vary"] = "Origin"
    end
  end

    post "/api/v1/account/cancel", headers: account_headers("acme", token: agent_token), as: :json
    assert_response :forbidden

          return
        end

        @current_account = Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain)
        if @current_account.nil?
          render json: { error: "Account not found" }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def authenticate_user!
        token = extract_bearer_token
        if token.blank?
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        @current_session = Session.authenticate(account: current_account, raw_token: token)
        if @current_session.nil?
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        @current_user = @current_session.user
      end

      def require_active_account!
        if current_account.cancelled?
          render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_owner!
        unless current_account.owner?(current_user)
          render json: { error: "Only the account owner can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_staff!
        unless current_user.staff?
          render json: { error: "Only staff can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_customer!
        unless current_user.customer?
          render json: { error: "Only customers can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def extract_bearer_token
        auth_header = request.headers["Authorization"].to_s
        match = auth_header.match(/\ABearer\s+(\S+)\z/i)
        match ? match[1] : nil
      end

      def require_object_param(key, source: params)
        value = source.require(key)
        unless value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          raise ActionController::ParameterMissing.new(key)
        end
        value
      end

      def extract_optional_comment_param(envelope)
        return nil unless envelope.key?(:comment)

        value = envelope[:comment]
        return nil if value.nil?

        unless value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          raise ActionController::ParameterMissing.new(:comment)
        end

        value
      end

      def parse_positive_int(raw, default:)
        return default if raw.blank?

        value = Integer(raw.to_s.strip, 10)
        value >= 1 ? value : default
      rescue ArgumentError, TypeError
        default
      end

      def pagination_params
        page = parse_positive_int(params[:page], default: DEFAULT_PAGE)
        per_page = [ parse_positive_int(params[:per_page], default: DEFAULT_PER_PAGE), MAX_PER_PAGE ].min
        [ page, per_page ]
      end

      def paginate(relation)
        page, per_page = pagination_params
        count = relation.count
        total_pages = (count.to_f / per_page).ceil
        offset = (page - 1) * per_page

        records = if count == 0 || offset >= count
                    []
                  else
                    relation.limit(per_page).offset(offset).to_a
                  end

        next_page = page < total_pages ? page + 1 : nil
        previous_page = if page <= 1 || total_pages == 0
                          nil
                        else
                          [ page - 1, total_pages ].min
                        end

        {
          records: records,
          meta: {
            count: count,
            page: page,
            per_page: per_page,
            next_page: next_page,
            previous_page: previous_page
          }
        }
      end

      def serialize_portal(account)
        {
          name: account.name,
          subdomain: account.subdomain
        }
      end

      def serialize_account(account)
        {
          id: account.id,
          name: account.name,
          subdomain: account.subdomain,
          status: account.cancelled? ? "cancelled" : "active",
          cancelled_at: account.cancelled_at&.iso8601,
          created_at: account.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: account.updated_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_user(user)
        {
          id: user.id,
          account_id: user.account_id,
          name: user.name,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role,
          verified: user.verified?,
          email_verified_at: user.email_verified_at&.iso8601,
          created_at: user.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: user.updated_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_session(session)
        {
          id: session.id,
          token: session.raw_token,
          created_at: session.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: session.updated_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_request(ticket)
        {
          id: ticket.id,
          subject: ticket.subject,
          status: ticket.status,
          requester_id: ticket.requester_id,
          created_at: ticket.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: ticket.updated_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_ticket(ticket)
        {
          id: ticket.id,
          subject: ticket.subject,
          status: ticket.status,
          requester_id: ticket.requester_id,
          requester: {
            id: ticket.requester.id,
            name: ticket.requester.name,
            email: ticket.requester.email
          },
          created_at: ticket.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: ticket.updated_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_comment(comment)
        {
          id: comment.id,
          body: comment.body,
          public: comment.public,
          author: {
            id: comment.author.id,
            name: comment.author.name
          },
          created_at: comment.created_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def render_validation_errors(record)
        render json: {
          error: record.errors.full_messages.first || "Validation failed",
          errors: record.errors.messages
        }, status: :unprocessable_content
      end

      def render_ticket_and_comment_errors(ticket, comment = nil)
        errors = {}
        full_messages = []

        ticket.errors.messages.each { |k, v| errors[k.to_s] = v }
        full_messages.concat(ticket.errors.full_messages)

        if comment
          comment.errors.messages.each { |k, v| errors["comment.#{k}"] = v }
          comment.errors.full_messages.each { |msg| full_messages << "Comment #{msg.downcase}" }
        end

        render json: {
          error: full_messages.first || "Validation failed",
          errors: errors
        }, status: :unprocessable_content
      end
    end
  end
end

module Api
  module V1
    class RequestsController < BaseController
      before_action :resolve_account!
      before_action :authenticate_user!
      before_action :require_active_account!
      before_action :require_customer!

      def index
        relation = customer_tickets.recently_active
        result = paginate(relation)

        render json: {
          requests: result[:records].map { |ticket| serialize_request(ticket) }
        }.merge(result[:meta]), status: :ok
      end

      def show
        ticket = find_customer_ticket!
        render json: { request: serialize_request(ticket) }, status: :ok
      end

      def create
        request_envelope = require_object_param(:request)
        comment_envelope = extract_optional_comment_param(request_envelope)

        ticket = current_account.tickets.build(
          requester: current_user,
          subject: request_envelope.permit(:subject)[:subject],
          status: Ticket::OPEN
        )
        comment = Comment.new(
          account: current_account,
          ticket: ticket,
          author: current_user,
          body: comment_envelope&.permit(:body)&.[](:body),
          public: true
        )

        ticket_valid = ticket.valid?
        comment_valid = comment.valid?

        unless ticket_valid && comment_valid
          render_ticket_and_comment_errors(ticket, comment)
          return
        end

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          ticket.save!
          comment.save!
        end

        render json: { request: serialize_request(ticket.reload) }, status: :created
      end

      def update
        ticket = find_customer_ticket!
        request_envelope = require_object_param(:request)
        comment_envelope = extract_optional_comment_param(request_envelope)

        comment = if comment_envelope
                    Comment.new(
                      account: current_account,
                      ticket: ticket,
                      author: current_user,
                      body: comment_envelope.permit(:body)[:body],
                      public: true
                    )
                  end

        invalid_status_message = nil
        if request_envelope.key?(:status)
          requested_status = request_envelope[:status]
          if requested_status == Ticket::SOLVED
            ticket.status = Ticket::SOLVED
          else
            invalid_status_message = "can only be set to solved"
          end
        elsif comment.present? && [ Ticket::PENDING, Ticket::SOLVED ].include?(ticket.status)
          ticket.status = Ticket::OPEN
        end

        ticket_valid = ticket.valid?
        if invalid_status_message
          ticket.errors.add(:status, invalid_status_message)
          ticket_valid = false
        end

        comment_valid = comment.nil? || comment.valid?

        unless ticket_valid && comment_valid
          render_ticket_and_comment_errors(ticket, comment)
          return
        end

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          ticket.save! if ticket.changed?
          comment.save! if comment.present?
        end

        render json: { request: serialize_request(ticket.reload) }, status: :ok
      end

      def comments
        ticket = find_customer_ticket!
        relation = ticket.comments.visible_to_customers.chronological.includes(:author)
        result = paginate(relation)

        render json: {
          comments: result[:records].map { |comment| serialize_comment(comment) }
        }.merge(result[:meta]), status: :ok
      end

      private

      def customer_tickets
        current_account.tickets.for_requester(current_user)
      end

      def find_customer_ticket!
        customer_tickets.find(params[:id])
      end
    end
  end
end

      before_action :authenticate_user!
      before_action :require_active_account!
      before_action :require_staff!

        relation = current_account.tickets.recently_active.includes(:requester)
        result = paginate(relation)

        render json: {
          tickets: result[:records].map { |ticket| serialize_ticket(ticket) }

      end

        render json: { ticket: serialize_ticket(ticket) }, status: :ok
      end

      def update
        ticket = current_account.tickets.includes(:requester).find(params[:id])
        ticket_envelope = require_object_param(:ticket)
        comment_envelope = extract_optional_comment_param(ticket_envelope)

        invalid_status_message = nil
        if ticket_envelope.key?(:status)
          requested_status = ticket_envelope[:status]
          if requested_status.is_a?(String) && Ticket::STATUSES.include?(requested_status)
            ticket.status = requested_status
          else
            invalid_status_message = "is not included in the list"
          end
        end

        comment = nil
        public_invalid = false
        if comment_envelope
          is_public = true
          if comment_envelope.key?(:public)
            if [ true, false ].include?(comment_envelope[:public])
              is_public = comment_envelope[:public]
            else
              public_invalid = true
            end
          end

          comment = Comment.new(
            account: current_account,
            ticket: ticket,
            author: current_user,
            body: comment_envelope.permit(:body)[:body],
            public: is_public
          )
        end

        if invalid_status_message
          ticket.errors.add(:status, invalid_status_message)
          ticket_valid = false
        end

        if comment
          comment_valid = comment.valid?
          if public_invalid
            comment.errors.add(:public, "must be a boolean")
            comment_valid = false
          end
        end

        unless ticket_valid && comment_valid
          render_ticket_and_comment_errors(ticket, comment)
          return
        end

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          ticket.save! if ticket.changed?
          comment.save! if comment.present?
        end

        render json: { ticket: serialize_ticket(ticket.reload) }, status: :ok
      end

        relation = ticket.comments.chronological.includes(:author)

For `Ticket`, I'll confirm subject presence, length limits, whitespace normalization, status inclusions, the default status, and requester-account relationships, along with the `recently_active` scope. The `Comment` tests will need to nail down the body presence (no blanks or whitespace, content preservation!), the `public` flag (defaulting to true, allowing false, and rejecting nulls), the ticket/author-account association, the `updated_at` touch on the parent ticket, the `chronological` scope, and the `visible_to_customers` scope. Third, and probably the most extensive, are the **Integration tests**: These will be the ultimate acid test. I'm breaking these into two main sections: customer registration and flows, and requests and tickets.

The customer section will be verifying correct registration, with checks for role escalation and sending verification emails with the correct frontend URL and tenant parameters. It will test the whole process: signing in and out, viewing and updating profiles, changing and resetting passwords, and testing failure scenarios like duplicate emails, validation errors, and registration attempts on cancelled accounts or missing tenants.

The Requests & Tickets section is even more involved. This is going to cover all the API interactions: creating requests, listing requests, viewing requests, reading comments, listing tickets, viewing tickets. There'll be validation on atomic errors – invalid statuses and comments, and authorization and multi-tenancy isolation. I'll need to thoroughly test access control across different user roles and businesses (including cancelled accounts and purging data). Then, there are comments! I'll be working through the `public` flag behavior and ensuring that customers can't create non-public comments, staff can, and that comment visibility is correctly implemented.

I'll also have to test the order of tickets and comments across different events like new tickets, staff replies, and customer replies. cd /app && bash -c '
set -euo pipefail
PORT=3456
bin/rails server -p $PORT -b 127.0.0.1 -P /tmp/smoke_puma.pid > /tmp/smoke_puma.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
cleanup() {
  kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
  wait $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -f /tmp/smoke_puma.pid /tmp/smoke_puma.log
  bin/rails runner "Account.find_by(subdomain: \"smoke-acme\")&.destroy!" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/up >/dev/null; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 0.2
done

echo "--- 1. Create business account ---"
curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/account/create \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"account\":{\"name\":\"Smoke Acme\",\"subdomain\":\"smoke-acme\",\"admin\":{\"name\":\"Jo\",\"email\":\"jo@smoke.test\",\"password\":\"owner-password-1\"}}}"
echo ""

echo "--- 2. Register customer ---"
curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/registrations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Helpdesk-Account: smoke-acme" \
  -d "{\"user\":{\"name\":\"Avery\",\"email\":\"avery@example.test\",\"password\":\"my-customer-password\"}}"
echo ""

# Verify both users directly in dev DB (as email delivery is log-only in dev without SMTP)
bin/rails runner "Account.find_by!(subdomain: \"smoke-acme\").users.each(&:verify_email!)"

echo "--- 3. Sign in owner and customer ---"
OWNER_TOKEN=$(curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/sessions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Helpdesk-Account: smoke-acme" \
  -d "{\"session\":{\"email\":\"jo@smoke.test\",\"password\":\"owner-password-1\"}}" | ruby -rjson -e "puts JSON.parse(STDIN.read).dig(\"session\", \"token\")")

CUSTOMER_TOKEN=$(curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/sessions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Helpdesk-Account: smoke-acme" \
  -d "{\"session\":{\"email\":\"avery@example.test\",\"password\":\"my-customer-password\"}}" | ruby -rjson -e "puts JSON.parse(STDIN.read).dig(\"session\", \"token\")")

echo "--- 4. Customer opens request ---"
REQ_RESP=$(curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/requests \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Helpdesk-Account: smoke-acme" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CUSTOMER_TOKEN" \
  -d "{\"request\":{\"subject\":\"Cannot download my receipt\",\"comment\":{\"body\":\"The download button does nothing.\"}}}")
echo "$REQ_RESP"
TICKET_ID=$(echo "$REQ_RESP" | ruby -rjson -e "puts JSON.parse(STDIN.read).dig(\"request\", \"id\")")

echo "--- 5. Staff lists tickets ---"
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/tickets \
  -H "X-Helpdesk-Account: smoke-acme" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OWNER_TOKEN"
echo ""

echo "--- 6. Staff replies and marks pending ---"
curl -sS -X PATCH http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/tickets/$TICKET_ID \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Helpdesk-Account: smoke-acme" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OWNER_TOKEN" \
  -d "{\"ticket\":{\"comment\":{\"body\":\"Please try again now.\"},\"status\":\"pending\"}}"
echo ""

echo "--- 7. Customer replies (reopens) ---"
curl -sS -X PATCH http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/requests/$TICKET_ID \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Helpdesk-Account: smoke-acme" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CUSTOMER_TOKEN" \
  -d "{\"request\":{\"comment\":{\"body\":\"Works on Chrome, not Safari.\"}}}"
echo ""

echo "--- 8. Customer reads paginated comments ---"
curl -sS "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/v1/requests/$TICKET_ID/comments?page=1&per_page=2" \
  -H "X-Helpdesk-Account: smoke-acme" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CUSTOMER_TOKEN"
echo ""
'
